summary: Iteration 5 backend regression + new tests for Character Folio (V2) and Session Recap (LLM via emergentintegrations + Claude Sonnet 4.5). Added 10 new tests (3 TestCharacterFolio + 7 TestRecap incl. 404/403/400/desc-order). 80/81 pytest cases pass (98.8%). All 71 prior tests still green; the 3 WebSocket tests that regressed in this run due to deprecated `websockets.exceptions.InvalidStatusCode` were fixed by adding the new `InvalidStatus` exception type — this is a websockets-lib version drift, NOT a backend regression. The single remaining failure is the carry-over CORS preflight test (FRONTEND_URL='' / wildcard handling) — unchanged RCA from iterations 3 & 4. LLM recap calls used: 2 (narrative + bullet) — within the ≤4 budget.

minor.issue: Carry-over: when FRONTEND_URL is empty/wildcard, allow_origins=['*'] short-circuits the regex, so preflight returns '*' instead of the explicit origin. Same RCA as iter_3/iter_4. Not a new regression.

On LlmChat exception the handler raises 502 with the raw exception text (HTTPException(502, f'Recap generation failed: {e}')) — could leak provider stack details. Consider logging `e` server-side and returning a sanitized message.

action_items: (carry-over) CORS preflight: either set FRONTEND_URL to the real preview URL or change server.py so when FRONTEND_URL is empty/'*' we pass allow_origins=[] + rely on allow_origin_regex only.
Optional hardening: in generate_recap() catch LlmChat errors more narrowly and log the original exception instead of returning it in the 502 body.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1383 lines (was 1280). Strongly recommend modular split: auth.py, campaigns.py, invites.py, characters.py, sessions.py, recap.py, ws.py.
generate_recap (server.py:1242) imports `emergentintegrations.llm.chat` inside the try block on every request — fine for cold-start safety, but logs nothing on failure. Add logger.exception().
list_recaps returns rows directly without a stable response model; consider Pydantic ResponseModel so the client API stays typed (currently any keyspace change leaks through).

CharacterIn.folio is `Dict[str, Any]` with no inner validation. Free-form is intentional per spec, but at least cap journal/goals list lengths and entry sizes server-side to prevent oversized documents (single character could DoS Mongo doc size).

Recap doc stores user_id+name at write time but no soft delete / GM-vs-member view differentiation. If a recap is generated by a player containing GM-only chat, all members see the full text. Consider tagging recaps with visibility (gm_only / shared) or filtering chat by visibility before sending to the LLM.
update_character (PUT) accepts CharacterIn (full body); a partial client that omits `folio` will reset it to `{}`. Same default-reset issue raised for CampaignIn in iter 4 — applies here too.
No rate-limit on /sessions/{sid}/recap. LLM calls cost real credits; a malicious GM could spam → cost overrun. Add per-session+per-user cooldown (e.g., 30s).

seed_data_creation: Tests create disposable TEST_-prefixed campaigns + characters that are deleted via fixture finalizers. New module-scoped recap_session fixture creates one TEST_Recap_* campaign + session seeded with 5 chat messages, used for all 3 LLM-invoking tests; campaign is deleted at module teardown. recaps collection in MongoDB will accumulate entries from successful recap calls (no API to delete recaps yet — minor cleanup gap).
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now has 81 tests across 20 classes. New classes: TestCharacterFolio (3), TestRecap (7). New fixture: recap_session (module-scoped, seeds 5 chat msgs). LLM recap costs ~2 calls per full pytest run (narrative + bullet styles). The 'in-character' style is intentionally NOT tested by the suite — third style was skipped to keep LLM cost ≤2 calls per run; main agent can self-test in-character via curl if needed. Pre-existing failure: TestCORS::test_preflight_preview_origin_ok — same RCA as iterations 3/4 (FRONTEND_URL handling). WS tests now resilient to both old and new websockets-lib exception types.
rca of the issue: Pre-existing CORS issue: server.py builds allow_origins=['*'] when FRONTEND_URL is empty, which causes Starlette's CORSMiddleware to echo '*' back regardless of the regex. Fix: when FRONTEND_URL is missing, pass allow_origins=[] so allow_origin_regex takes precedence. No new bugs in iteration 5 — folio round-trips correctly, recap returns id/session_id/style/text/by_user_name with text>=80 chars in narrative style, GET /recaps lists DESC, 404/403/400 permission checks all return correct status codes.
